results.name: Tools directory is relative to the executable, not the caller working directory
Missing folder is an empty collection and scanning does not create it
Scan includes nested EXEs and shortcuts but excludes data and DLLs
Refresh discovers new, renamed and removed tools
Removed and out-of-folder paths cannot be launched
EXE launch preserves Unicode, spaces and the tool working directory
Windows shortcut preserves its target, arguments and own working directory
Native launch button starts only the selected tool and closing leaves the child alive
